name: triple
description: Triple's delivery policy for supervised pilots: Disputes/PCI path locks, EARS requirements and Linear as the system of record. Pair it with HARNESS_PROFILE="triple", which refuses unattended merges.
decides: A pilot ADR puts the project under Triple's delivery policy (the Disputes pilot).

options.description: Park authentication, billing and payments, migrations, PCI evidence, secrets and infrastructure: agents may not write them, card data is refused, and those paths and terms make a task not low-risk (no light lane, no policy approval).
